title: Schema Wizard: incremental onboarding microcopy, states, and release screenshots
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and assets for a guided 'Schema Wizard' that helps new users create JSON schema definitions during quickstart. Goal: reduce confusion about required properties, show example-driven rendering, and make inline validation actionable. Deliver a set of microcopy variations, modular screenshot assets for the release notes and docs, and final spec for the engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with annotated flows for three onboarding paths (Basic, Advanced, Import existing schema)
8 annotated UI screenshots (desktop + mobile) in PNG export ready for docs and release notes
Microcopy variants for tooltips, inline errors, toast messages, and a short help panel (reviewed and approved)
Validation UI states documented: empty, soft-warning, hard-error, success with suggestions
Handoff artifact (component props table + CSS token mapping) in Confluence and linked in PR
Accessibility checklist completed (contrast, keyboard nav, screen reader labels)
Localization-ready strings extracted to i18n spreadsheet
tasks: Design 3 flows in Figma: Basic guided schema -> generate example -> preview; Advanced schema editor -> live validation; Import JSON -> canonicalize and edit
Write microcopy variants and rationales (short, contextual, progressive disclosure versions)
Create screenshot set for docs: hero quickstart, validation inline, suggestions drawer, preview of generated mock output
Prepare a smaller set of animated GIFs for the console tour (60s each max)
Export tokens and create a simple handoff doc for engineering (props, states, aria labels)
Coordinate with PM to sync acceptance criteria and ensure no blocking UX decisions remain
Run an accessibility sweep and capture a11y notes for eng implementation
decisions: Use progressive disclosure instead of a single complex form to lower cognitive load for new users
Show generated example payload live as users fill required fields (preview panel, left-aligned)
Inline validation uses soft warnings for optional fields and hard errors for missing required properties
Add a 'Suggest defaults' button that auto-completes example values based on type and common patterns
Keep schema import flow non-destructive and open an explicit 'apply changes' confirmation before saving
open_questions: Should the 'Suggest defaults' logic be configurable per org (via Console settings)?
How granular should the validation guidance be for nested arrays/objects to avoid overwhelming beginners?
Do we support server-side schema normalization (reformatting whitespace, ordering properties) or leave it to the client?
reviews: PM review (Anika Patel): requested clearer separation between 'preview' and 'example' terminology - action: update copy by 2026-03-07
Eng review (Diego Ramos): flagged performance risk of live validation on very large schemas - action: add debounce and max-node check
Security review (Priya Singh): requested that import flow display a warning about sensitive keys - action: add microcopy and help link
feedback_log: 2026-03-06: Initial concept walkthrough with PM/Eng. Positive on progressive disclosure. Noted need for localization-ready strings.
2026-03-08: Copy round 1. Short form preferred for tooltips; Keep longer examples in help panel.
2026-03-10: Accessibility notes added: ensure role="region" for preview and aria-live for validation toasts.
2026-03-12: Screenshot review with docs team. Requested a higher-contrast callout and a simplified error example for release notes.
implementation_notes: Provide a 'validationSeverity' enum in props: none | soft | hard | success
Expose callbacks for 'onImport', 'onSuggestDefaults', and 'onApply' for telemetry and testing
Limit live validation to first 500 nodes; show 'partial validation' badge if truncated
Bundle screenshot assets in release branch under /docs/assets/schema-wizard/ with 2x retina exports
next_steps: Finalize microcopy variants and push to i18n spreadsheet by 2026-03-14
Deliver final PNG/JPEG screenshot exports and GIFs for the release notes by 2026-03-16
Create PR with handoff docs and example component usage before dev cycle starts (target 2026-03-18)
Schedule quick dev sync to confirm debounce/limits and final prop names (2026-03-13)
Run a small usability test (5 participants) on 2026-03-15 for Basic flow
